name: Checkbox
description: A single checkbox with a label — toggles one independent option on or off.

props.name: label
props.description: The label text. The Figma set shows a nested Label instance but exposes no text property, so there is nothing to bind yet; expose it in Figma and re-extract to close the gap.

props.name: checked
props.description: Checked state. The Figma set has only a Style axis — no Selected or State axis — so the checked look is not designed yet. Radio binds the same prop to its Selected variant.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Exists in the component, has no design counterpart.

props.name: tile
props.description: Tile presentation (bordered, padded). Code only; no Figma variant.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional icon beside the label. Code only; the design shows the check glyph as an internal instance, not a swappable slot.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name, forwarded to the native input.

props.name: value
props.description: Form field value, forwarded to the native input.

notes: Native input with a real <label>, so the hit area includes the text.
Indeterminate is a property, not a third value.
Group related controls in a fieldset with a legend (1.3.1).

Exposes a native checkbox role with the label programmatically associated, so assistive tech announces the label and the checked/unchecked state (WCAG 2.2 AA · SC 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value; SC 1.3.1 Info & Relationships).
Keyboard: Tab moves focus to the checkbox, Space toggles it; the focused state shows a visible focus ring (SC 2.1.1 Keyboard; SC 2.4.7 Focus Visible).
Because the checkmark and label use s2a/color/content/default, contrast is maintained in both light and dark themes (SC 1.4.3 Contrast Minimum).
